title: ALL ( fact table ) as a CALCULATE filter removes the filters on the related dimensions
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "Red", [Sales Amount], "AllSales", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( Sales ) ), "AllQuantity", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( Sales[Quantity] ) ) ), Product[Color] = "Red" )

source.quote: ALL ( Sales ) acts as REMOVEFILTERS on the expanded version of Sales, removing filters from the table and from all related dimension
source.supports: ALL ( Sales ) removes filters from the expanded Sales table, the dimensions included

source.quote: ALL with a table works on the expanded table, removing filters
source.supports: the page's example: under a color filter, ALL ( Sales ) returns the same amount as ALL ()

derivation: Under Product[Color] = Red: Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460. ALL ( Sales ) removes the filters from every column of expanded Sales, Product[Color] included: the total, 540. ALL ( Sales[Quantity] ) removes filters from that one column only; the color filter stays: 460.
